checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'campaign-report'.

checks.description: The report fills the report-artifact body fields.
checks.rule: Body and template include results, what_worked, what_to_change, and learnings_log_ref, matching runtime/handoff-contract.md.

checks.description: Results are measured against the strategy-artifact success_metric.
checks.rule: Body restates and reports against the success_metric set in the strategy-artifact, and stops-and-asks if it is absent, never inventing a metric after the fact.
Body requires every what_worked claim to carry a number with its source and window; no claim without evidence.
Body states no vanity metrics and names examples (impressions, raw reach, follower count) that do not substitute for the success_metric.

checks.description: What to change is concrete and aimed at the next brief, as a recommendation.
checks.rule: Body requires what_to_change to be concrete and for the next brief, framed as a recommendation, never an action taken on a live campaign or a spend.

checks.description: Optional supporting cuts are anchored to the success_metric and never replace it or add vanity metrics.
checks.rule: Body and template offer an optional supporting-cuts section (a funnel-stage view and a per-segment cut drawn from the strategy-artifact segments) that supports the success_metric, never replaces it, and never reintroduces vanity metrics (impressions, raw reach, follower count) into the verdict.

checks.description: Each what_to_change item carries an owner and a target date or brief.
checks.rule: Body and template require every what_to_change item to carry an owner and a target date (or target brief), so each recommendation is trackable and accountable; no owner-less or date-less change.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the skill files.
checks.rule: No file in this skill contains the U+2014 em dash character.
No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) appear in any file; digits are 0-9 only.

checks.description: No tatweel or kashida in any Arabic text.
checks.rule: No file contains the U+0640 tatweel character.
